P.note: Full card fits the 800px frame with a saturated blue sky, electric green hills and a blue-tinted acrylic slab, though the bubbles and glossy orbs lean toward generic Aero decoration.

Q.note: The card reads as a nearly opaque pale plate rather than transparent acrylic, and the Up Next list is cut off so the fourth track is not visible.

R.note: Translucent blue card and glassy art are on brief, but the card runs past the bottom of the viewport and clips the last Up Next row.

S.note: The card overflows both top and bottom so the Tide header and top of the artwork are cropped, which breaks the layout at 1280x800.

T.note: The whole player fits cleanly with glossy blue acrylic and a hilltop green horizon, but white text on the pale Up Next rows has weak contrast.

U.note: The glass-drop artwork and pale blue-white horizon are crafted, but the card is clipped at the bottom so the fourth track is cut off and the card feels more solid than translucent.
